characters.prompt: [CAMERA] Inside a RIGHT-hand-drive Japanese Toyota HiAce-type passenger van at night, photographed from the middle bench seat looking forward, 35mm, eye level. [CHARACTER] A heavy-set Japanese man in his forties with a shaved head and a black nylon bomber jacket sits in the LEFT front passenger seat, seen from behind; his head is turned a little to the right so only the back and side of his shaved head and his thick neck are visible, NO face, NO eye mask. In the RIGHT front seat the driver: a dark shoulder and two hands in black gloves on the steering wheel, NO mask, face not visible. [ACTION] The escort is barking an order over his shoulder without turning around. [SETTING] Grey cloth seats and headrests, a small dark navigation screen in the centre console between the two front seats, the steering wheel on the RIGHT, dark cabin lit only by the dashboard glow and cold blue-white street lights streaking past the tinted windows, the empty night road through the windscreen. NOT anime, NOT illustration, NOT 3d render.
